judge: independent judge, did not write the miner and did not mine (2026-11-23, Opus); round 5
reference: design/specs/2026-11-15-mod-ledger-entry-standard.md rule sheet and §2.2; round-3 verdicts <Mod>_round3.judge.json for the rubric (same standard, so rounds compare)
standard_applied: FAITHFUL = true to the ticket's full record and to the repo today, the right kind and state, one fact a holder would act on. WRONG = a claim a holder would act on that the ticket's full record, the repo or the game copy contradicts today (an overtaken trap, a conclusion the record refutes). NARRATION = true but refused by rule 7 or the entry test (lifecycle, restatement, not about the mod). MISSED = right as far as it goes but drops the ticket's deciding fact or proof, or cites the wrong sha for it. Tag/bar slips alone are noted, not ruled (as in round 3).
pass_rule: >= 18 FAITHFUL and 0 WRONG of 20; rule per entry FAITHFUL / WRONG / NARRATION / MISSED

refusal.evidence: 14 FAITHFUL of 20 (needs 18); 0 WRONG. Non-FAITHFUL: 47, 77, 196 MISSED; 99, 110, 194 NARRATION. The pass fails even without the two narrowest rulings (194, 196): 16.
refusal.would_pass: A sample with >= 18 FAITHFUL and 0 WRONG.
